## History

Phillips obtained his schoolmaster teaching position through his uncle, who served as a trustee, and boarded at the home of Eben Wright. During his time teaching in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he administered several punishments to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), forcing her to stand at the blackboard after she smashed her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head and later making her sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). At the conclusion of the school term, Phillips departed from his position, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over his exit despite her previous mixed feelings toward him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Prissy Andrews's mentor at school, though their relationship extends beyond the classroom into a romance. He courts Prissy by giving her gifts of flowers and paying her compliments. His open partiality toward her is well known among the local schoolchildren who observe their interactions.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
